case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3506725 at 0.90 for $1,000.03, an online purchase on card C10434-K1. The strongest findings are that the customer confirmed making the purchase when contacted, and the model's calibrated risk indicates that only 9 % of similar product R transactions in this score band were fraud during the reference period. The case was determined to be legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.03. The recommended actions are to allow the transaction, create a case record, and close it with no fraud finding.
